patch_description: This approach estimates how much traffic each link could attract using a fractional, demand-weighted two-hop routing model. It uses those estimates to reward useful direct links and penalize pairs of links that are likely to carry correlated traffic. Unlike a broad reward for every two-hop path, the sparse positive couplings emphasize congestion and diminishing returns, encouraging a more balanced low-energy network. Couplings are limited to links sharing an endpoint, keeping the interaction graph manageable.
